domain.description: Public domain name resolving to this host. Used by Caddy for automatic TLS and as Forgejo's ROOT_URL / SSH_DOMAIN.

admin_username.description: Username for the initial admin account, created on first boot.

admin_password.description: Password for the initial admin account. Create-only: editing this in config.json AFTER first boot will not rotate the admin password — rotate via `forgejo admin user change-password` over SSH.

admin_email.description: Email for the initial admin account.
